MediaPipe Tasks Vision 0.10.21 and Face Landmarker
Copyright Google LLC and MediaPipe contributors.

This directory contains unmodified, version-pinned third-party runtime assets
from @mediapipe/tasks-vision and the official Face Landmarker model bundle.
Application code is maintained separately in ../core.mjs, ../renderer.mjs,
../app.mjs and ../vision.worker.js.

Upstream project: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/v/0.10.21
Model overview: https://ai.google.dev/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/face_landmarker
Model: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_landmarker/face_landmarker/float16/1/face_landmarker.task

Apache License 2.0 is included in LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt.

Selfie Segmenter (unmodified model):
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/image_segmenter/selfie_segmenter/float16/1/selfie_segmenter.tflite

Hand Landmarker (unmodified, float16 version 1 model bundle):
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/hand_landmarker/hand_landmarker/float16/1/hand_landmarker.task
https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/hand_landmarker
